structural_and_source_quote_checker_verd: PASS within the explicitly limited literal/format contract
block_grading_tools_verdict: Four concrete validation/policy/preservation issues require attention; no actual reader or grade was evaluated.

checks.finding: The shared template supplies no game rule, expected answer or actual failed ID. It restricts readers to their own frozen summary/questions and three outputs, preserves complete initial visible delivery and all ordered IDs, and explicitly requires identical treatment except role/path.

checks.criterion: Individual requested clauses, short exact ordinary facts and minimal computations
checks.finding: V5 explicitly splits compound requests, quotes a short exact ordinary supporting span for each request, uses additional ledger items for noncontiguous passages, rejects repeated whole-section substitutes and confines explicit case conclusions/calculations to requested concrete scenarios.

The source-only heading index, exact full-slice hashes and once-only answer attachments remain. Readers must follow procedural references, definitions, phase transitions and exceptions when needed; a bare cross-reference or keyword match cannot substitute for the operative fact.

Both checkers expressly limit themselves to format/literal checks. Fact-source relevance, complete requested coverage, calculations, contradictions and factual correctness remain independently graded. No structural flag is presented as a semantic correctness grade.

checks.verdict: pass for the stated literal-source contract
checks.finding: The fact checker requires quote source selection and clause reference, literal contiguous membership in the declared source section, and rejects a whole section as the short fact. Synthetic invented and unselected quotes failed; valid exact quotes and explicit unsupported clauses without sections behaved as intended. Shortness, relevance and adequate clause splitting remain semantic/protocol checks rather than inferred from literal membership alone.

checks.verdict: pass for valid unique IDs; duplicate guard required
checks.finding: Packets retain complete parsed reader entries without quote deduplication or field removal, including extra nested fields; merge retains complete_raw_entry. Duplicate raw IDs can be silently collapsed before that guarantee, as V5-T04 documents.

checks.criterion: All substantive same-entry fields and excluded labels
checks.finding: answer, ledger supported_fact_or_case_result, case_conclusions and evidence.quote are represented without borrowing from another entry. Top-level metadata, requested_clause and evidence locations are excluded. Nested case-conclusion metadata and the marker-dependent answer-only fallback violate the requested boundary in the cases documented by V5-T02/T03. Semantic graders must still distinguish operative quotations from headings or other non-factual text.

Required material parts are matched exactly to the scope requirements, valid status values are enforced, and Correct classifications require all parts covered. Literal quotation matching occurs against the selected same-entry content, but empty support quotes currently bypass it, as V5-T01 documents. These checks validate the grader artifact; they do not independently establish that the quotation proves the requirement.

checks.criterion: Final report preference and original preservation
checks.finding: The merge selects grades-same-entry.json whenever it exists, otherwise grades.json. Synthetic tests confirmed the selected source_grade_report, intact original grade file, retained full entry, and refusal to overwrite an existing results output. Preparation uses a new directory, and originals are not rewritten.

concrete_issues.problem: A covered material part accepts reader_quotes=[""]. The list is truthy, and an empty string is a substring of every substantive string, so both current assertions pass without an actual support quotation. Whitespace-only quotes can likewise count as non-factual support when present in the answer.
concrete_issues.synthetic_observation: The real merge function completed with a covered synthetic requirement whose sole reader quote was empty.
concrete_issues.required_fix: Require each supplied reader quote to be a string with non-whitespace content, then verify the original exact quote occurs in an allowed substantive same-entry field. Covered parts must have at least one such valid quotation. Keep factual relevance with the semantic grader.

concrete_issues.problem: Recursive flattening of every dictionary value under case_conclusions includes nested confidence and summary_location metadata. That allows a location/confidence label alone to pass the material quote-location check, contrary to the explicit same-entry substantive-content boundary.
concrete_issues.synthetic_observation: A synthetic case_conclusions object with an actual result plus confidence/location labels produced all three strings. A covered part quoting only its confidence label was accepted by merge. Top-level confidence/location, clause requested labels and evidence locations were correctly excluded.
concrete_issues.required_fix: Define and validate the substantive shape of case_conclusions, for example plain conclusion/calculation strings, or extract only declared factual result/calculation leaves and exclude metadata recursively. Preserve the original complete entry even while filtering the quote-validation view.

concrete_issues.problem: Selecting grades-same-entry.json does not itself activate same-entry quote validation. The allowed fields still switch to answer-only unless a separate same-entry-grading-clarification.json marker exists. V5 already establishes the all-substantive-fields policy, so the same valid ledger-only quotation is accepted or rejected based on that additional presence check.
concrete_issues.synthetic_observation: With grades-same-entry.json present in both cases, a synthetic ledger-only operative quote was rejected without the marker and accepted with it. No actual run or marker file was inspected.
concrete_issues.required_fix: Activate the declared same-entry policy explicitly for v5/same-entry reports, or require and validate a captured policy version before merging. Avoid silently reverting to answer-only validation for a selected same-entry report. Legacy report compatibility may remain explicit.

concrete_issues.problem: Reader answers are converted directly to an ID-keyed dictionary before duplicate/count/order validation. Duplicate raw IDs can silently discard an earlier full entry while preparation still writes a manifest claiming complete lossless raw-entry preservation.
concrete_issues.synthetic_observation: A synthetic reader array containing two distinguishable entries with the same sole expected ID was accepted; only the second entry appeared in the packet. Normal unique-ID entries, including custom nested fields, were preserved exactly.
concrete_issues.required_fix: Validate the original ordered raw ID list/count/uniqueness against the full question list before constructing dictionaries. Reject malformed duplicates rather than dropping them or attempting to grade them.

synthetic_tests.method: Executed the allowed base checker and block-tool functions in isolated namespaces. The fact-check function was compiled from its allowed AST with the allowed base checker injected, avoiding module cache writes. All synthetic summaries/questions/entries/grader artifacts and filesystem operations were in-memory objects/dictionaries. No fixture or real output files were read or written.

cases.case: whole section substituted as short fact rejected
explicit unsupported clause without a source section accepted structurally
complete normal raw nested entry preserved
same-entry report preferred and originals/output preservation guards hold
empty reader quote accepted as covered support
nested conclusion confidence/location treated as substantive quotation candidates
ledger-only quote validation depends on separate marker despite same-entry report preference
duplicate raw IDs accepted and earlier full entry discarded

repair_scope: Tool validation and declared content-policy routing only. Preserve all original entries/artifacts. No asked-fact, answer-key or question-scope change is suggested. Keep semantic grading separate from structural checks and do not require guessed sources for unsupported clauses.
